therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: restoration of iron homeostasis and cellular energy metabolism
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with iron deficiency (with or without anemia) and chronic heart failure
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Six-minute walk test distance at 4, 12, and 24 weeks; NYHA class at weeks 4, 12, and 24

dose_info.schedule: Weekly during correction phase; monthly during maintenance phase (up to week 24)
dose_info.dose_modifications: Final dose may be 100 mg depending on individual iron deficit; total dose calculated based on individual iron deficit

context.indication: Chronic heart failure with iron deficiency
context.investigator_commentary: Positive FAIR-HF study data are available, this study is identical as EFFICACY-HF. Due to low recruitment in EFFICACY-HF the decision was made to terminate it.

results_by_chain.mechanism_description: iron repletion via intravenous iron supplementation
results_by_chain.biology_description: restoration of iron homeostasis and cellular energy metabolism
results_by_chain.population_description: Patients with iron deficiency (with or without anemia) and chronic heart failure
